handoffExposesOnly: order.quantityUnit (closed object {quantity: UNAVAILABLE, unit: UNAVAILABLE}; a unitless reader result never becomes a per-order EACH fact)
handoffWithholds: quantityUnit (per-order unit/quantity: UNAVAILABLE for this reader; the erp-order-capability-cell vocabulary ERP_ORDER_CREATE_DISCRETE_UNITS_V1/DISCRETE_UNITS/EACH is retained only as explicitly non-evidentiary capability metadata)
actualAvailableOutput.customerReader: createErpReadAdapterV1 LIST_CUSTOMERS, drained to completion across pages by its own cursor (bounded page ceiling, per-page readback re-verification, consistent page identity, no repeated page content)

revenueBoundary.proves: bounded order/customer/status/quantity-unit/period facts from the actual released reader
notDerivedFrom: caller-rehashed reader results (raw rehashed records are never authority at the rebind boundary)
revenueBoundary.rule: net revenue must never be inferred from order status or ordered quantity; absent currency/amount/history/delivery facts remain unavailable

checks: retained source identity outside the substituted payload (sourceLabel, sourceBytes, sourceBytesSha256, contract, now)
customer cursor drain to completion with bounded page identity checks

serializationBoundary.carried: the binding (which embeds the closed unsupportedFacts contract) plus its digest, together with the independently retained identity: sourceLabel, sourceBytes, sourceBytesSha256, the released contract and the decision time
serializationBoundary.survives: JSON round-trip of the binding plus its digest, re-derived by re-executing the actual released readers against the retained identity; the explicit unsupported/missing semantics are returned on rebind (equality asserted, not just status counts)
denies: caller-rehashed forged reader result carried as a binding against the retained source (SERIALIZED_BINDING_MISMATCH)
ressealed substituted source plus its matching new binding (source-plus-binding substitution; SERIALIZED_BINDING_MISMATCH)
retained sourceBytesSha256 that does not match the carried source bytes (SOURCE_BYTES_MISMATCH)
customer page identity drift within the drain (CUSTOMER_PAGE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH)
an undrained customer source still carrying a nextCursor (CUSTOMER_SOURCE_PAGINATION_UNRESOLVED)

acceptance.positive: the actual released order reader composes into bounded supported order/customer/status/period facts with independently expected values; the customer reader is drained across pages and a third customer on page two is joined (never UNAVAILABLE); per-order quantity and unit are UNAVAILABLE, never EACH
negative: ressealed source plus matching binding substitution
unitless reader result must not become a per-order EACH fact (quantityUnit stays UNAVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE)
acceptance.mutationRule: denied before any persisted mutation; no revenue is ever inferred; raw caller-rehashed reader facts are never authority

nonClaims: No production ERP qualification or complete KS238 capability is claimed.
No order-management, write, approval, network, provider, runtime, publication or public-write authority is granted.
The KS guided question/source/period CLI remains owned by Flash and is not duplicated here.
Unsupported revenue/order-intake aggregates remain explicit and unavailable.
Per-order quantity and unit are not evidenced by the selected source or the released reader and remain UNAVAILABLE; the capability-cell vocabulary is non-evidentiary here.

authorityBoundary.rawReaderResults: NON_AUTHORITY: verifyOrderSourceRead and the customer-page verification are internal, non-authoritative projections over caller-owned results (shape + caller-recomputable readback hash); a caller-rehashed projection is never approval
authorityBoundary.approval: only where the released readers are executed by the handoff itself against independently selected source bytes, released read contract and decision time
authorityBoundary.rebindContract: rebindSerializedOrderSource({sourceLabel, sourceBytes, sourceBytesSha256, contract, now, binding, bindingDigest}) accepts no caller-owned reader results; it re-executes the released readers against the identity retained outside the substituted payload
authorityBoundary.drain: the customer reader is drained to completion by cursor before joining; an unread page is never labelled a missing customer fact
